checks.name: artifact-reproduction
checks.command: run all fourteen arms into a fresh temporary directory and diff against frozen artifacts

checks.name: research-lineage
checks.command: validate campaign, convergence, program, and research contracts

findings: The research experiment imports no private Body surface and regenerates all fourteen artifacts byte-for-byte through the public Harness boundary.
Ten isolated transitions survived; sparse shared opportunity, delayed multisurface alignment, scale selectivity, and the one-joint composition were scientifically falsified.
Four consequence-renewed continuation cycles survived, so generic missing continuation and generic irreversible strength are not supported explanations for the frozen one-joint failure.
The core harness preserves causal-local, shuffled, delayed-return, far-output, checkpoint, replay, and natural-quiescence controls; 18 tests passed and two unchanged adversarial tests remain ignored.
The representative warm regression completed in 0.25 seconds, strictly under 10 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: The first compositional divergence inside the one-joint world is not yet localized between consequence order, next competition, and motor integration.
Isolated survival under supplied prerequisites does not establish necessity, unrestricted transfer, or body-scale authority.
No candidate physics was adopted; the sweep remains discovery evidence over the exact dirty tree identified by the candidate receipt.
